_about: Hierarchy: production system → observed stress → causal pathway. Production systems group the archetypes (archetypes.json); socio-economic is cross-cutting. Each production system lists its observed stresses, and each observed stress lists causal pathways: a group id from 'groups' (rules '<group>.<rule>' in causal_graph.json) or a stand-alone rule id. An observed stress is shown only where its production system's signal is on, and is flagged when any of its rules of the same type is triggered; its intensity is the highest among them. A rule can sit under several production systems (flood_exposure). Opportunity rules inside a stress group (groundwater.recharge_opportunity, productivity.rice_fallow_opportunity) roll up separately as that observed stress's opportunities.

aggregation.trigger: any rule of the same type triggered, where the production system is present
